function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of the most prominent vaccine manufacturers around the world (as of 2026).  These companies produce a wide range of vaccines—from routine childhood shots to COVID‑19, influenza, HPV, and emerging‑pathogen platforms.

| # | Company | Headquarters | Key Vaccine Platforms | Notable Products |
|---|---------|--------------|-----------------------|------------------|
| 1 | **Pfizer‑BioNTech** | New York, USA / Mainz, Germany | mRNA, protein subunit | BNT162b2 (Comirnaty) – COVID‑19; Prevnar 23 (pneumococcal) |
| 2 | **Moderna** | Cambridge, USA | mRNA | mRNA‑1273 (Spikevax) – COVID‑19; RSV vaccine (in development) |
| 3 | **Johnson & Johnson (Janssen)** | New Brunswick, USA | Viral vector (Ad26) | Ad26.COV2.S (Johnson & Johnson COVID‑19) |
| 4 | **Novavax** | Gaithersburg, USA | Protein subunit | NVX-CoV2373 (COVID‑19) |
| 5 | **AstraZeneca** | Cambridge, UK | Viral vector (ChAdOx1) | AZD1222 (COVID‑19) |
| 6 | **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK)** | Brentford, UK | Inactivated, subunit, conjugate | Shingrix (shingles), HPV vaccines, influenza |
| 7 | **Sanofi Pasteur** | Paris, France | Inactivated, subunit, conjugate | Fluzone (influenza), Menveo (meningococcal) |
| 8 | **Merck & Co. (MSD)** | Kenilworth, USA | Inactivated, subunit, conjugate | Gardasil (HPV), RotaTeq (rotavirus) |
| 9 | **Bharat Biotech** | Hyderabad, India | Inactivated, subunit | Covaxin (COVID‑19) |
|10 | **Sinovac Biotech** | Beijing, China | Inactivated | CoronaVac (COVID‑19) |
|11 | **Sinopharm (BBIBP‑CorV)** | Beijing, China | Inactivated | COVID‑19 vaccine |
|12 | **CureVac** | Tübingen, Germany | mRNA | CVnCoV (COVID‑19, in trials) |
|13 | **Biontech (German subsidiary of Pfizer)** | Mainz, Germany | mRNA | Same as Pfizer‑BioNTech |
|14 | **Takeda Pharmaceutical** | Tokyo, Japan | Inactivated, subunit | Rotarix (rotavirus), HPV vaccine |
|15 | **Serum Institute of India** | Pune, India | Inactivated, subunit | Covishield (AstraZeneca‑Oxford) |
|16 | **Boehringer Ingelheim** | Ingelheim, Germany | Inactivated, subunit | Influenza, RSV (in development) |
|17 | **Roche** | Basel, Switzerland | Inactivated, subunit | Influenza, HPV (in partnership) |
|18 | **Bayer** | Leverkusen, Germany | Inactivated, subunit | Influenza, HPV (in partnership) |
|19 | **Eli Lilly** | Indianapolis, USA | Inactivated, subunit | Influenza, RSV (in development) |
|20 | **GSK Vaccines** | Brentford, UK | Inactivated, subunit, conjugate | Shingrix, HPV, influenza |

### Emerging & Platform‑Focused Companies
- **CureVac** – mRNA platform, expanding beyond COVID‑19.
- **Arcturus Therapeutics** – lipid‑nanoparticle mRNA platform.
- **Sangamo Therapeutics** – gene‑editing platform for vaccine delivery.
- **Vaxart** – oral, self‑amplifying RNA vaccines.

### Key Points to Remember
- **mRNA**: Pfizer‑BioNTech, Moderna, CureVac, Arcturus, etc.
- **Viral Vector**: AstraZeneca, Johnson & Johnson, Sputnik V (Gamaleya).
- **Inactivated**: Sinovac, Sinopharm, Bharat Biotech, Serum Institute.
- **Protein Subunit**: Novavax, Sanofi, GSK, Merck.
- **Conjugate & Subunit**: GSK, Sanofi, Merck, Takeda.

If you need deeper details on a specific manufacturer, their pipeline, or regional production facilities, just let me know!
